title: A question about a step, then "I did step 3" (what was done, not how it went). The mentor never calls note_said for either, and the asked entry has nothing said

turns.say: /ask-mentor Make the rock shake from where the hammer hits.
Why is the rock riding on a null?

note: Spec 014 T078 (negative twin of 26). 'Not for questions' and a said-only-when-they-said-it entry: turn 2 is a question, turn 3 only says what was done (the read can describe it, TD 6 turn 4), neither says how it went.
